# USETOOLBENCH

> Free online productivity tools, Indian financial calculators, document utilities and SAP Business One learning resources.

## Tools
- [All tools](https://usetoolbench.in/tools/): Browse available utilities.
- [PDF tools](https://usetoolbench.in/pdf-tools/): PDF editing and document utilities.
- [GST calculator](https://usetoolbench.in/gst-calculator/): Estimate Indian GST.
- [EMI calculator](https://usetoolbench.in/emi-calculator/): Estimate loan installments.
- [SIP calculator](https://usetoolbench.in/sip-calculator/): Estimate investment outcomes.

## Learning
- [SAP Business One training](https://usetoolbench.in/learn/sap-b1/): SAP B1 modules and business processes.
- [SAP B1 SQL practice](https://usetoolbench.in/learn/sap-b1/sql-practice/): Practice read-only SQL queries.

- [Sitemap](https://usetoolbench.in/sitemap.xml)

Financial estimates are informational. Tool availability and limits may vary. Private administration routes are not included.
